dashboard.title: Overview

orders.title: Orders
orders.telegramBusy: Already sent or being sent right now.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Add your first product.
products.name: Name

productForm.translationHint: If Russian or English is left empty, the Armenian text is shown instead.
productForm.slugHint: Used in the product link: /products/{slug}. Latin letters, numbers and dashes.
productForm.stockHint: Leave empty if made to order. When set, sales stop automatically at zero.
productForm.isAvailableHint: Turn off to show the product as unavailable.
productForm.isPublishedHint: Turn off to hide the product completely (draft).
productForm.imagesHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 5 MB each. The first photo is the main one.
productForm.fileWrongType: {name}: only JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images are allowed.
productForm.tooManyImages: A product can have at most {max} photos.
productForm.slugTaken: This link name is already used by another product.
productForm.deleteText: The product and its photos will be deleted. Past orders keep their details.

errors.invalidSlug: Use lowercase Latin letters, numbers and single dashes.
errors.invalidPrice: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
errors.invalidStock: Enter a whole number, 0 or more, or leave empty.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Categories group products in the shop and appear as filters.
categories.deleted: Category deleted. Its products now have no category.
categories.slugTaken: This link name is already used.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete this category? Products will stay but lose this category.

settings.title: Shop settings
settings.deliveryFeeHint: Added to every order. Use 0 for free delivery.
settings.freeThresholdHint: Orders with a subtotal of at least this amount ship free. Leave empty to disable.
settings.invalidUrl: Enter a full link starting with https://
settings.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
